outcome: rehospitalization/emergency room access within the first week from discharge
cohort: Newborns born to mothers with or without COVID-19 who underwent early discharge from the Fondazione Policlinico Gemelli hospital between January 1, 2022, and February 28, 2022.
finding: Early discharge for newborns born to mothers with COVID-19 is a safe strategy, as their rehospitalization/emergency room access rates within the first week from discharge were comparable to those of newborns from uninfected mothers.
